source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 923 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 923 was established by Ordinance No. 29426, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 13, 2014. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 923 is established on property generally located on the northwest line of Bernal Drive, approximately 250 feet southwest of Palacios Avenue. The size of PD 923 is approximately 37,500 square feet. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district.

(d) For the purpose of a child-care facility use, this district is considered a single building site. This provision expressly allows a playground area and parking areas to be on adjacent lots within this district. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 923A: development/landscape plan. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For a child-care facility use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 923A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A- 4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-5(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district, etc.

(b) The following main use is permitted by right:

-- Child-care facility. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls).

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Child-care facility use.

(1) Front yard.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(B) For that portion of the building up to 50 feet in width and shown on the development/landscape plan, front yard setback is 0 feet.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(3) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 10,000 square feet.

(4) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 30 percent.

(5) Building placement.

(A) Except playground equipment and one accessory structure 200 square feet or less, no structure is permitted within 150 feet of Odessa Street.

(B) One accessory structure a maximum of 700 square feet may encroach into a utility easement subject to compliance with 51A-8.602(f). (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Parking restrictions for a child-care facility use.

(1) Ingress to and egress from Odessa Street is prohibited.

(2) Off-street parking is prohibited within 150 feet of Odessa Street.

(3) Except as provided in this subsection, off-street parking is allowed in the required yards. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Fencing For A Child-Care Facility Use
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.110. FENCING FOR A CHILD-CARE FACILITY USE.

(a) A maximum eight-foot-tall fence may be provided in the required front yard along Bernal Street as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) A minimum six-foot-tall solid screening fence must be provided adjacent to parking areas as shown on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Child-care facility. For a child-care facility, landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(c) Maintenance. Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29426)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-923.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 29426)
